title: Parkio Daily for November 13, 2026
teaser: Bryan Cranston hinted Carousel of Progress reopens May 2027; EPCOT Festival of Holidays menus drop with 98 new items starting Nov 27.

breaking.title: Bryan Cranston suggests Carousel of Progress returns May 2027
breaking.body: During a surprise appearance at EPCOT's La Cava Experience, actor Bryan Cranston mentioned that the reimagined Carousel of Progress at Magic Kingdom may reopen in May 2027. Disney has not officially confirmed the timeline.

parkioInsight.text: If the May window holds, spring 2027 crowds at Magic Kingdom may spike during opening week. Consider visiting Tomorrowland in late April or waiting until June for lower waits.

bignews.title: Full menus released for EPCOT Festival of Holidays with 98 new items
bignews.body: EPCOT's International Festival of the Holidays runs November 27 through December 30 with 20 Holiday Kitchens offering 98 new dishes, desserts, and drinks. The festival also debuts the first-ever Figment holiday popcorn bucket.

parkioInsight.text: Festival booth lines tend to peak between noon and 3pm. Hit World Showcase kitchens before 11am or after 5pm to avoid the longest waits and secure specialty items before they sell out.

bignews.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party nearly sold out for 2026
bignews.body: All November dates for Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party have sold out, and only two December dates remain available for purchase. The special ticketed event runs select nights at Magic Kingdom through December.

parkioInsight.text: If you're planning to attend and haven't bought tickets, book one of the two remaining December dates immediately. Once sold out, resale tickets are typically unavailable through official channels.

bignews.title: Imagineers enhance Remy's Ratatouille Adventure with new props
bignews.body: EPCOT's Remy's Ratatouille Adventure received new set pieces designed to conceal screen seams and improve immersion. Imagineering also added Easter eggs throughout the attraction.

parkioInsight.text: The updates are subtle but add polish worth a reride. Queue times for Remy tend to dip after 7pm when families head to dinner; that's often your best window for a second look.

bignews.title: Fantastic Four meet-and-greet debuts at Avengers Campus ahead of Doomsday film
bignews.body: Disneyland's Avengers Campus will host character experiences tied to Avengers: Doomsday, which releases December 18. The Fantastic Four will appear for interactive Super Hero encounters.

parkioInsight.text: Avengers Campus character queues often exceed 45 minutes during launch periods. Arriving at rope drop or during the 5–6pm dinner window usually cuts wait times in half.

topstories.title: Holiday decorations complete on Disneyland's Main Street U.S.A.
topstories.body: Garlands, wreaths, and ornaments now cover Main Street U.S.A. buildings and the Train Station at Disneyland. The installation completes the park's transformation for the holiday season.

parkioInsight.text: Main Street photo spots are least crowded in the first 30 minutes after park open and during the final hour before close. Afternoon sun creates harsh shadows; early morning or dusk lighting works best.

topstories.title: Disney California Adventure Festival of Holidays guide now available
topstories.body: The printed Festival Guide for Disney California Adventure's 2026 Festival of Holidays is in park and details all food marketplace offerings, entertainment, and activities for the event.

parkioInsight.text: Grab a guide at the park entrance to map your booth route before crowds arrive. Festival marketplace lines are shortest in the first hour of park operation and tend to thin out after 8pm.

topstories.title: DVC announces 2027 Moonlight Magic dates for Walt Disney World
topstories.body: Disney Vacation Club members can register for free Moonlight Magic after-hours events in 2027 at EPCOT, Animal Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Typhoon Lagoon. No events are scheduled for Magic Kingdom or any Disneyland park.

parkioInsight.text: Registration for Moonlight Magic typically fills within hours of opening. Set a calendar alert and log in early on registration day to secure your preferred park night.

topstories.title: Disney reveals 2027 military discounts across parks and cruises
topstories.body: Military families can access special ticket pricing for 2027 visits to Walt Disney World, Disneyland, Disney Cruise Line, and Aulani. The announcement follows Universal Orlando's 2027 Military Freedom Pass reveal.

parkioInsight.text: Military discount tickets often have blackout dates around spring break and major holidays. Book as early as possible and verify eligible travel windows to avoid peak pricing periods.

topstories.title: Star Wars 50th anniversary reimaginings planned for Disney parks in 2027
topstories.body: Lucasfilm and Disney previewed Star Wars 50th anniversary celebrations coming to Walt Disney World, Disneyland, and Disney Cruise Line in 2027. Details on reimagined offerings will be shared closer to the anniversary year.

parkioInsight.text: Anniversary events at Disney parks historically draw heavy crowds for several months. If you're visiting Galaxy's Edge in early 2027, rope drop and Lightning Lane will be essential tools.

topstories.title: Disneyland holiday entertainment lineup detailed with parade and fireworks
topstories.body: Disneyland's holiday season features returning favorites including the Christmas parade, nighttime fireworks spectacular, and holiday ride overlays at Haunted Mansion and other attractions.

parkioInsight.text: Parade and fireworks viewing spots fill 60–90 minutes before showtime on weekends. Weekday performances and the second parade slot (when offered) usually offer easier viewing with fewer guests.

topstories.title: Santa Claus meet-and-greet returns to Disney Springs
topstories.body: Guests can meet Santa Claus at Disney Springs without a park ticket. The character experience is now available at the shopping and dining district.

parkioInsight.text: Santa meet lines at Disney Springs tend to be shortest on weekday mornings before 11am. Waits often exceed an hour on weekend afternoons and evenings during the holiday season.

icymi.title: Disney files two trademarks for Walt Disney Imagineering merchandise
icymi.body: Disney Enterprises filed trademark applications for Walt Disney Imagineering on November 10, covering clothing, jewelry, and other consumer goods. The move suggests expanded Imagineering-branded merchandise may be coming.

icymi.title: New Star Wars and Pixar Fijables collectibles arrive at Disneyland
icymi.body: Miniature Fijables figures featuring The Mandalorian, Toy Story, and Monsters Inc. characters are now available at Disneyland Resort for $4.99 each, with discounts when buying three.

icymi.title: Meet the Robinsons pin released at Walt Disney World
icymi.body: A new rectangular pin featuring Lewis, Wilbur Robinson, and Carl the Robot from Disney's Meet the Robinsons is available at Walt Disney World for $14.99.

icymi.title: Lucasfilm restores original Star Wars movie title for 50th anniversary
icymi.body: The 1977 film will once again be called simply Star Wars, dropping the Episode IV - A New Hope subtitle added in 1981. The change marks the franchise's 50th anniversary in 2027.

spotlight.title: ABC films Disney Parks holiday special at Hollywood Studios this week
spotlight.body: Kelly Clarkson and Derek Hough are filming segments for the ABC Disney Parks Holiday Special at Hollywood Studios. Production includes live performances and seasonal content scheduled to air later this year.

parkioInsight.text: Filming typically closes sections of Sunset Boulevard and Hollywood Boulevard intermittently. Check the app for real-time closures and plan alternate routes to Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster during midday hours.
